SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, DR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, DR.REVIEW_TYPE AS reviewType, DR.TARGET_ID AS targetId, DR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, DR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, DR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, DR.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, DR.REQ_DATE AS reqDate, DR.ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, DR.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, H.NAME AS hospitalName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.REG_DATE AS reviewRegDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DR.REQ_DATE DESC, DR.REQUEST_ID DESC) AS rn
) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST WHERE STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' AND REVIEW_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL'

SELECT DR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, DR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, DR.REVIEW_TYPE AS reviewType, DR.TARGET_ID AS targetId, DR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, DR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, DR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, DR.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, DR.REQ_DATE AS reqDate, DR.ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, DR.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, H.NAME AS hospitalName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.REG_DATE AS reviewRegDate FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST DR LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = DR.REVIEW_TYPE LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_HOSPITAL H ON H.HOSPITAL_ID = DR.TARGET_ID JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = DR.BIZ_NO WHERE DR.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED', ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'

UPDATE TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO FROM TB_BUSINESS B JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = B.BIZ_ID OR M.EMAIL = B.BIZ_ID WHERE B.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
